description: This Java source file defines the ServiceMcaCondition class used for evaluating conditions related to email messages in the OFBiz framework. The class can evaluate conditions based on message headers, fields, or service responses, and is used for conditional processing of mail-related services.

classes.name: ServiceMcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition for email message evaluation, supporting checks on headers, fields, or service responses. Implements logic to evaluate these conditions based on specified operators and values.

methods.name: ServiceMcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on XML element and condition type (field, header, or service).

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given message and context, returning true if the condition passes, false otherwise.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific fields from the email message, such as recipients, subject, dates, or body content.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from message parts, including multipart messages.
